description: This file defines a React functional component named 'RevisionContentLocked', which displays a message and interface for users with restricted access to version history based on their subscription plan. The component utilizes MobX for state management, renders UI elements including an illustration, text, and a button, and dynamically adjusts displayed content based on the user's subscription status.

methods.name: getPlanHistoryDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration limit for the user's subscription plan, used to inform users about their history capacity.

methods.name: getPremiumContentCopy
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the user's history limit based on their subscription plan.
